contract.draftkings_note: DraftKings' own rules page could not be retrieved (help pages render client-side / return not-found to non-browser fetch). pr-460 asserts 'per published DraftKings General Rules'. Third-party sportsbook rule texts (BetNow, BetJets, Betgr8) agree with the 2-way-push / 3-way-draw split but are NOT DK. Contract enforcement therefore relies on market labelling at capture, not on DK text.
contract.known_gap_both_versions: A partial capture (e.g. H + TIE rows only) is paired as a two-way market and the TIE row is priced as the away team. Pre-existing in da0c1503 and b353de86; not changed by this transition. Needs a capture/adapter guard (not a frozen-model edit).
contract.three_way_period_ml: A market with a Tie/Draw selection loses both team bets on a tie; the Tie leg wins. The model has NO three-way pricing. Three-row boards (H/A/TIE) and any market not named 1H_ML/1Q_ML are skipped with no price (fail closed, both versions; see equivalence contract_probes).
contract.two_way_period_ml: Selections are exactly the two teams; a tied period is refunded (push). Modeled push = P(|margin|<0.5).
